overview: Financial markets face pressure as tech stocks tumble alongside ongoing concerns over massive artificial intelligence spending and a massive cryptocurrency hack. In commercial real estate news, property owners and developers continue to secure major refinancing and leasing deals across various markets. Locally in San Francisco, observers highlight the parallels between the current artificial intelligence funding boom and past corporate fraud. Meanwhile, Kauai's tourism sector has taken a significant hit following disruptions from recent hurricanes.

items.title: Tech Stocks Tumble, Putting Pressure on Broader Market
items.summary: The S&P 500 faces a small loss for October as tech stocks slide, pressured by heavy losses in artificial intelligence shares.

items.title: Binance’s $6.3 Billion Hack Is Just the Start of a Risky New Era
items.summary: Binance suffered a $6.3 billion hack as attackers increasingly use artificial intelligence and advanced techniques to steal and launder cryptocurrency.

items.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn
items.summary: US tech stocks fell sharply with the Nasdaq opening at its lowest level in over two months as AI spending nears $1 trillion.

items.title: Why the Markets Don’t Care About the Midterms
items.summary: Market analysts note that factors like inflation, interest rates, AI, and the war with Iran matter far more to markets than midterms.

items.title: Grassroots Analytics Doubles D.C. Footprint With 25K-SF Office Lease
items.summary: Grassroots Analytics signed a nearly 25,000-square-foot office lease at Arch Square in Washington, D.C., doubling its local footprint.

items.title: Juda Chetrit Seals $55M Recap for 1384 Broadway
items.summary: The Chetrit Organization secured a $55 million loan from Maxim Capital Group to recapitalize an 80 percent occupied office building on Broadway.

items.title: Greystone Refis Hollywood, Fla., Apartments With $109M Loan
items.summary: A joint venture secured a $109 million Freddie Mac-backed loan through Greystone to refinance a multifamily asset in Hollywood, Florida.

items.title: Lightstone Capital Provides $29.5M Loan for Orange, N.J., Multifamily Development
items.summary: Peek Capital secured a $29.5 million bridge loan from Lightstone Capital for its recently completed multifamily development in Orange, New Jersey.

items.title: The man who exposed Elizabeth Holmes has a warning about AI
items.summary: Whistleblower Tyler Shultz warns that the current artificial intelligence money boom provides the perfect setup for the next Theranos-style fraud.

items.title: ‘We were blindsided’: Popular Mediterranean restaurant forced out by landlord
items.summary: Popular Mediterranean restaurant Oasis Grill was forced to close its 1st Street location after losing its lease.

items.title: Mayor’s ‘strong’ policies leave SFPD with Flock data longer than other Bay Area cities
items.summary: San Francisco police are retaining Flock data longer than other Bay Area cities due to a strict 2023 city ordinance.

items.title: Hurricane fallout batters Kauai tourism, weighs on statewide visitor numbers
items.summary: September visitor numbers dropped across Hawaii as hurricanes disrupted travel and dealt a major blow to Kauai's tourism sector.

items.title: Taxpayers To Fund Mainland TV Host’s ‘Hidden Hawaiʻi’ Show
items.summary: A mainland travel show hosted by Peter Greenberg will receive up to $584,000 in taxpayer funding through a no-bid contract.

items.title: Maui Prosecutor To Hire Investigator Focused On Post-Wildfire Contractor Fraud
items.summary: The Maui prosecutor's office is hiring an investigator specifically focused on post-wildfire contractor fraud following recent investigative reports.

wiki.title: John Adams
wiki.extract: John Adams was a Founding Father and the second president of the United States from 1797 to 1801. Before his presidency, he was a leader of the American Revolution that achieved independence from Great Britain. During the latter part of the Revolutionary War and in the early years of the new nation, he served the Continental Congress of the United States as a senior diplomat in Europe. Adams was the first vice president of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797. He was a dedicated diarist and regularly corresponded with contemporaries, including his wife and advisor Abigail Adams and his friend and rival Thomas Jefferson.
